nodes.label: Injection Testing for Dynamic Query Components
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: injection testing for dynamic query components

nodes.label: Record Construction with create vs make
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: record construction with create vs make

nodes.label: defer() Post-Response Work
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Lightweight post-response work without retries or crash durability; runs in the same PHP process after response.

nodes.label: Exception report()/render() Methods
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Keep exception behavior beside the exception definition or centralized in bootstrap/app.php callbacks.

nodes.label: ShouldDispatchAfterCommit
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Delays event dispatch until all open transactions commit; discards event if transaction rolls back.

nodes.label: Explicit HTTP Timeouts
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Default 30s timeout is too long; set connectTimeout and timeout appropriate to the service.

nodes.label: Retry Only Safe Operations
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Retry transient failures for idempotent requests only; state-changing requests need idempotency keys.

nodes.label: afterCommit() for Queued Mail
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Call afterCommit() on queued mailable dispatched during transaction to prevent processing before commit.

nodes.label: retry_after Timeout
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: retry_after must exceed longest worker timeout by safety margin to prevent double-processing of running jobs.

nodes.label: Implicit Route Model Binding
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Let Laravel resolve models from route parameters instead of manual findOrFail lookup.

nodes.label: Scoped Bindings
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Scope nested route bindings so child resources must belong to their parent; does not replace authorization.

nodes.label: Idiomatic Laravel Syntax
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Prefer helpers like session(), back(), now(), ->latest(), ->value() for clearer intent.

nodes.label: Laravel Naming Conventions
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Singular StudlyCase models, plural snake_case tables, camelCase methods/variables, kebab-case views.

nodes.label: Atomic Locks
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Cache::lock() for concurrent execution serialization; lockForUpdate() for row-level locking inside transactions.

nodes.label: Atomic Conditional Write (Cache::add)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Cache::add() atomically writes only when key does not exist, preventing race conditions on cache-miss logic.

nodes.label: Throttle Exception Reports
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Configure throttle() with Lottery or Limit to sample/rate-limit exception reports from failing integrations.

nodes.label: Job Batches (Bus::batch)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Monitor a group of jobs with callbacks on completion/failure; not a database transaction.

nodes.label: RateLimited Queue Middleware
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Queue middleware for sharing third-party API quotas across jobs.

nodes.label: retryUntil() Time-Based Limits
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Time-based alternative to attempt count; takes precedence over $tries.

nodes.label: ShouldBeUnique Jobs
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Enforce only one queued instance of a logical job via cache lock; not a substitute for idempotent processing.

nodes.label: onOneServer() Single Server Execution
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Only one scheduler node runs the task; requires shared cache store with atomic lock support.

nodes.label: withoutOverlapping() Scheduling
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Prevent second run while previous holds lock; choose lock expiration carefully to avoid stale locks.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting Sensitive Endpoints
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Apply rate limits to login, password recovery, and expensive API routes; choose limiter key carefully.

nodes.label: Focused Controllers
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Controllers should coordinate HTTP input, authorization, validation, and response; extract substantial logic into actions.

nodes.label: Resource Routes
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use Route::resource() for standard resourceful actions; explicit routes for non-standard behavior.

nodes.label: Mass Assignment Control
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Define $fillable for allow-list or $guarded for block-list; never pass untrusted data with $guarded = []

nodes.label: Form Request Validation
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use form requests when validation or authorization is substantial, reused, or clearer outside controller.

nodes.label: Use Only Validated Data
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use validated() or safe() instead of $request->all(); select fields intended for the operation.

nodes.label: View Composer
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Centralize data needed whenever named Blade views are rendered; compatible with targeted views only.

nodes.label: Eager Loading
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Load relationships with with() to prevent N+1 query pattern; constrain eager loads when large columns are unnecessary.

nodes.label: Keep Queries Out of Blade Templates
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: keep queries out of blade templates
nodes.rationale: Prepare data before rendering; keeps query behavior visible and testable.

nodes.label: preventLazyLoading() Guard
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Development guard that throws LazyLoadingViolationException when accessing unloaded relationships.

nodes.label: Select Only Needed Columns
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Omit large text, binary, or JSON columns when not needed; retain every key Eloquent needs for relationship matching.

nodes.label: withCount() Relationship Counting
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use withCount() when only relationship counts are needed; loading and hydrating every related model wastes memory.

nodes.label: Attribute Casts
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use casts() method for automatic type conversion of attributes (boolean, array, decimal, datetime).

nodes.label: Model-Aware Queries
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Prefer Eloquent models for application queries to preserve casts, scopes, and table configuration.

nodes.label: Precise Relationship Types
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Define the relationship matching the database association with concrete return type (HasMany, BelongsTo).

nodes.label: whereBelongsTo() Query
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Expresses relationship constraint without manually specifying foreign key.

nodes.label: Foreign Key Constraints
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use constrained() when naming conventions and default actions match; avoid duplicate single-column indexes.

nodes.label: Action Class Pattern
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Extract a discrete business operation into an action class when it improves reusability or testability.

nodes.label: Constructor Injection
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Prefer constructor injection for lifetime dependencies to make them explicit and testable; avoid app()/resolve() service location.

nodes.label: Contract Boundaries
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Depend on contracts at system boundaries (payment gateways, external services) when testability or interchangeable implementations justify the abstraction.

nodes.label: Cache-Aside Read (Cache::remember)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Cache::remember() implements cache-aside without separate truthiness check; avoids treating falsy values as cache misses.

nodes.label: Cache Tags
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Group related cache entries for bulk invalidation; not supported by file, dynamodb, or database drivers.

nodes.label: Cache::memo() and once() Memoization
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: memo() retains resolved values in memory for one execution; once() memoizes a callback return value per request/job without external store.

nodes.label: Cache::flexible() Stale-While-Revalidate
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Serve stale data during a defined period and register a deferred refresh; not a durable background job.

nodes.label: cursor() vs lazy() Tradeoffs
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: cursor() hydrates individually from one query without eager loading; lazy() uses chunked queries with eager loading support.

nodes.label: lazyById() for Safe Iteration
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Paginates by monotonic key to prevent skipped/duplicate rows when updating records during iteration.

nodes.label: toQuery() Bulk Operations
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Build a query from Eloquent collection models instead of manually constructing whereIn clauses for bulk updates.

nodes.label: Incremental Data Processing (chunk/lazy)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use chunk, chunkById, lazy, or lazyById when loading entire result sets would exceed memory budget.

nodes.label: Queued Notifications
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Queue notifications calling external services; keep synchronous when immediate completion feedback is needed.

nodes.label: Explicit HTTP Error Handling
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: HTTP client returns 4xx/5xx responses by default; call throw() or inspect status explicitly.

nodes.label: Http::fake() for Testing
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Fake external integrations in tests with preventStrayRequests() and assertSent().

nodes.label: ShouldQueue Mailable
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Implement ShouldQueue on mailables when delivery should normally happen in background.

nodes.label: Global Scopes (Sparingly)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Silently modify every query on the model; reserve for truly universal constraints like soft deletes or multi-tenancy.

nodes.label: Local Scopes
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Extract reusable query constraints into local scopes to avoid duplication across controllers and queries.

nodes.label: Convention Detection Process
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Five-step process (Orient, Sweep, Open-ended pass, Confirm, Record) for documenting how a Laravel app actually writes code.

nodes.label: record-rule MCP Tool
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Persists detected conventions as path-scoped rules in .ai/rules for team and agent sharing.

nodes.label: env() Only in Config Files
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: env() must only be called from config files because cached config does not load .env; application code uses config().

nodes.label: Production Secret Protection
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Encrypt environment files or use platform native secret stores; never commit plaintext production secrets.

nodes.label: Encrypted Model Attributes
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use encrypted cast for recoverable sensitive values; TEXT columns needed for variable ciphertext length.

nodes.label: Context Facade
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Request-scoped data sharing across execution lifecycle without manual argument passing through layers.

nodes.label: Exception Context
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Attach structured data to exceptions through context() method for enriched log output.

nodes.label: Immutable Migrations
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: After a migration runs in production, create a new one for changes; editing old files makes fresh installs differ from upgraded.

nodes.label: Staged Migration Changes
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Adding required/unique columns to populated tables needs multi-step: nullable column first, backfill, then constraint.

nodes.label: Conditional Validation Rules
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use Rule::when(), required_if, or exclude_unless for explicit conditional validation.

nodes.label: Cross-Field Validation (after())
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use form request's after() method for validation depending on multiple fields or application state.

nodes.label: Composite Index Design
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Multi-column indexes whose column order supports the query's filters and ordering for common query patterns.

nodes.label: Conditional Aggregates
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Combine multiple counts over the same filtered dataset into one query using case expressions.

nodes.label: Subquery Pattern
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Correlated subqueries with addSelect() select a single relationship value without loading the full has-many collection.

nodes.label: Concurrency::run() Parallel Execution
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Run independent operations concurrently through Laravel's configured concurrency driver for performance gains.

nodes.label: $attributes->merge() Pattern
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Component attribute bag merges caller-provided values with defaults, with special class merging behavior.

nodes.label: Blade Fragments
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Return named fragments for partial rendering to htmx/Turbo clients without full view re-render.

nodes.label: Failover Cache Store
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Failover driver tries each configured store in order on exception; does not replicate data between stores.

nodes.label: Higher-Order Messages
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Concise alternative to closures for simple collection operations like each, map, filter, and sum.

nodes.label: ShouldntReport Interface
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Prevents Laravel's exception handler from reporting an exception type while keeping the policy visible.

nodes.label: HasLocalePreference
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Implement on notifiable models so notifications and mailables use recipient's locale, preserved for queued delivery.

nodes.label: On-Demand Notifications
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Send notifications to arbitrary addresses without creating dummy models.

nodes.label: Http::pool() Concurrent Requests
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Run several independent HTTP requests concurrently through a connection pool.

nodes.label: Markdown Mailables
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Render HTML and plain-text from Laravel mail components; useful for conventional transactional messages.

nodes.label: Honest Rollbacks
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Implement down() when safely reversible; document destructive rollbacks and prefer forward-fix in production.

nodes.label: Laravel Horizon
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Monitoring, balancing, metrics, and supervisor for Redis queues only.

nodes.label: runInBackground() Scheduling
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Long-running scheduled commands run independently without delaying later tasks.

nodes.label: Bind Query Parameters
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use parameterized queries instead of SQL interpolation; map user-selected identifiers to allow-lists.

nodes.label: CSRF Protection
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Include @csrf in state-changing Blade forms; Inertia uses XSRF-TOKEN cookie with Axios header.

nodes.label: Safe Upload Validation
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Validate content type, dimensions, and size; store outside public executable locations; re-encode if needed.

nodes.label: Str/Arr/Number/Uri Utilities
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Prefer Laravel utility classes when clearer or safer than native PHP equivalents.

nodes.label: Deferred Props
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Load data after initial page render for faster perceived page loads; requires handling undefined state with skeleton/empty states.

nodes.label: Inertia Form Component
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Recommended declarative form builder with render prop pattern exposing errors, processing state, progress, and reset semantics.

nodes.label: InfiniteScroll
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Automatically load additional pages of paginated data as users scroll.

nodes.label: Instant Visits
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Navigate immediately without waiting for server response; target component renders with shared props while page-specific props load in background.

nodes.label: Layout Props
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Share dynamic data between pages and persistent layouts without prop drilling.

nodes.label: Inertia Link Component
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Client-side navigation that preserves SPA behavior; using traditional <a> tags breaks the Inertia protocol.

nodes.label: Optimistic Updates
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Apply data changes instantly before server response with automatic rollback on failure for perceived performance.

nodes.label: Polling (usePoll)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Automatically refresh data at intervals with throttling for inactive tabs and manual start/stop control.

nodes.label: Prefetching
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Preload pages on hover or programmatically to improve perceived navigation performance.

nodes.label: useForm Hook
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Programmatic alternative to the Form component for imperative form control.

nodes.label: useHttp Hook
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Standalone HTTP requests that do not trigger Inertia page visits; same DX as useForm but for plain JSON endpoints.

nodes.label: WhenVisible
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Lazy-load a prop when an element scrolls into view; defers expensive below-fold data.
